title: HAI RUKHSATH KI GHADI AYE KARBALA WAALO KHUDA HAFEZ
body:
HAI RUKHSATH KI GHADI AYE KARBALA WAALO KHUDA HAFEZ
SALAAM-E-AAKHRI AYE KARBALA WAALO KHUDA HAFEZ
<<DIVIDER>>
NA HUMSEY HO SAKAAA KUCH BHI ADAA HAQ MEIZBAANI KA
HAI YEH SHARMINDAGHI AYE KARBALA WAALO KHUDA HAFEZ
<<DIVIDER>>
TUMHAAREY SAATH ZEHRA BHI YAHAAN TASHREEF LAATHI THI
YEH IZZATH BHI MILEE AYE KARBALA WAALO KHUDA HAFEZ
<<DIVIDER>>
HAMAAREY GHAR KI RAUNAQ BHI TUMHAAREY SAATH JAATHI HAI
UDAASI CHAA GAYI AYE KARBALA WAALO KHUDA HAFEZ
<<DIVIDER>>
KUCH AANSOO AANKH MAI KUCH DAAGH HAIN MAATAM KE
SEENAY PAR
HAI NAZRAANA YEHI AYE KARBALA WAALO KHUDA HAFEZ
<<DIVIDER>>
TUMHAAREY GHAM MAIN ROTHAY ROTHAY MARJAATEY THO ACCHA
THA
YEH HASRATH REH GAYEE AYE KARBALA WAALO KHUDA HAFEZ
<<DIVIDER>>
PAHOONCH KAR WAANH SAYEED-E-ZAAR KO BHI YAAD KARLEINA
HAI MAAROOZA YEHI AYE KARBALA WAALO KHUDA HAFEZ
